questions.stem: Which statement best defines Low angle?

options.text: It is a shot taken from below the subject, often making it appear powerful or threatening.

options.misconception: Confuses Low angle with High angle

options.text: It is a shot tilted so the horizon is slanted, suggesting unease or disorientation.
options.misconception: Confuses Low angle with Dutch angle

options.text: It is a move of the camera toward or away from a subject on a wheeled platform.

questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Low angle.
